title: Tooth Fairies
author: Passionateaboutcraft
description:
Add a sprinkle of magic to your crafts with our set of 4 cute whimsical tooth fairy images in PNG format! Each design features an adorable, playful tooth fairy with sparkling wings, charming details, and a fun, lighthearted style that is perfect for kids’ projects. These high-resolution images with transparent backgrounds are ideal for a variety of crafting ideas, from making tooth fairy-themed greeting cards and reward charts to decorating scrapbooks or DIY keepsakes. Bring a touch of enchantment and creativity to your crafting projects with these delightful tooth fairy images!
300dpi
5000 x 5000px
